description:
Text in Hebrew, probably a letter. Written on parchment. Describing a man who was robbed on the road. The robbers even took the document/letter (הכתב) that he had with him.

Mirror image imprints of these fragments may be found on the neighboring shelfmarks T-S AS 203.279 and T-S AS 203.280.
description_he: טקסט בעברית, כנראה מכתב. כתוב על קלף. מתאר איש שנשדד על הדרך. השודדים אפילו לקחו את הכתב (המסמך/המכתב) שהיה עמו.
